oracle: A delete swipe is authorized for the field and caret where its press/preview began. An explicitly observed transition to another identified field or a changed caret/privacy context before release must not apply that stale swipe to the new destination. A fresh selection in the same field may be deleted once under the recently established selection rule.

cases.sequence: Begin delete press/preview in identified A; host switches to identified B and reports fresh context; release stale swipe.
cases.expect: No deletion in B and no old-A undo payload offered for B.

cases.sequence: Begin delete press/preview in A; host moves caret within A and reports fresh context; release stale swipe.
cases.expect: No deletion at the unpreviewed caret.

cases.sequence: Begin delete press/preview in public A; host changes field privacy and reports fresh context; release stale swipe.
cases.expect: No stale swipe mutation in newly private context.

cases.sequence: Begin delete press/preview in A; host selects a fresh range within same identified A; release swipe.
cases.expect: Preserve recent selection-only behavior unless the whole gesture is explicitly cancelled; never delete outside selection.

limits: Do not count indistinguishable own-state echoes or permanently stale proxies as a demonstrated failure. Read-only initially; no root mutation or simulator use.
